Three Layers — One Instrument

01 — AUTHOR

React Bowtie Builder

Role-based authoring · 6-stage workflow: Draft → Safety Assessment → Compliance Review → Incident Investigation → Final Risk Review → Released · Every change versioned and signed

02 — WATCH

Signal Adapter → Bowtie Config Engine → Threshold Engine → Barrier Health Score (100 − signals − CAPA overdue − recurrence) → Escalation Flow · Pre-alerts <60 min

Deploy: ServiceNow-native (Now Experience) · OutSystems-native (ODC) · Full-Stack (React + Node.js + PostgreSQL + Docker)

The Gap

The Bowtie Is the Gold Standard. It Doesn't Know What's Happening Right Now.

Built Once
Created in workshops, stored in BowTieXP or PDFs, reviewed annually. They reflect the world as it was — not as it is. No real-time signal ingestion.
Watched Manually
A Compliance Officer opens a form, selects 'At Risk' from a dropdown, types a comment. Every barrier status update is a human manually noticing something.
Acted On Too Late
By the time a pattern of near-misses is visible in the quarterly review, the incident has already happened — or the threshold has been silently breached for weeks.
The gap is not in the methodology. The gap is between what's on paper and what's happening on site — right now. Sentio closes this gap with continuous signal intelligence and human-gated decision making.
